messages:
Sam H: morning async — what I did: finished prewarm script for eu regions, ran a small soak in us-west-2. blockers: eu-central-1 quota still at 0 for H100s, prewarm jobs time out on spot fallbacks. today: open ticket with cloud, try a canary on A100s, pinged Ajay for CR review.

Priya K: thx Sam. I dug into the quota — looks like net-new quota requests need a business justification. opened a request form with cost/usage tables, ref 224-req-ec1. pinged cloud-supp. ETA ~2 working days unless we escalate.

Sam H: ack. can you paste the request link? want to attach to the rollout doc.

Priya K: https://cloud.company/requests/224-req-ec1 — added notes: "Redwood inference canary, expected 20 H100-hours/day for 2 weeks". I also added a temporary ask for 8 A100s so we can run canary sooner.

Luca R: if cloud is slow, we can run the canary on A100s but perf delta vs H100 is ~15% on long sequences. that's acceptable for smoke. cost is ~x1.2 compared to spot H100. also suggest bumping prefix cache TTL to 10s during canary to save tokens.

Ajay S: I can pick up the CR for the canary automation today. which repo? is it `infra/prewarm` or `runtime/canary`?

Sam H: `infra/prewarm` + small runtime hook in `runtime/canary`. I'll drop a PR link in 30m.

Infra Bot: Ticket #CLOUD-4572 created for eu-central-1 quota. Status: open. Assigned to @cloud-ops. Priority: P2.

Marta V: quick note — faced the same timeouts last week; adding `--max-retries 5` helped for spot fallback dance. also include `--region-priority us-west-2,eu-central-1` in the job spec.

Sam H: good tip, Marta. I'll add retries + region-priority.

Ajay S: grabbing the CR now. will add e2e that simulates quota failure and validates fallback to A100. should post review by EOD.

Priya K: will follow up with cloud-ops to ask for expedite if we attach the rollout doc and impact statement.

Sam H: blockers list updated: (1) eu-central H100 quota (ticket CLOUD-4572) (2) flaky prewarm on spot evictions — trying `--max-retries 5` (3) need Ajay + runtime sign-off for canary.

Luca R: FYI — I kicked a quick metric scrape on headroom dashboards; queue depth spiked 12% last night in us-east-1. not critical but watchful.

Sam H: thanks — I'll add queue alert throttles to avoid noisy paging during the canary.

Marta V: also add a rollback policy in the canary job: if 95th latency > 2.5s for 5m -> abort and fall back to baseline model.

Sam H: noted. adding rollback + alert throttle. any other asks?

Ajay S: nothing else from me. posting CR in ~25. :thumbsup:

Priya K: will update the rollout doc once cloud responds.

Sam H: cool — thanks team. I'll post the PR + canary run plan here when ready.
